evidence: Quint. 1.7.14: geminīs, ut dīxī, vōcālibus scrīpsērunt
Traupman 27: ut prius dīxī, as I said earlier
terms.comment: In narrative the historians say ut suprā dictum est (Sall. J. 96.1) and sīcut ante dictum est (Nep. Dion 9.5), as Lewis & Short note s.v. dīcō.

sources: Lewis & Short: dico
